clearance_review: Separate the source leaf from its modeled U-shaped trim at the existing face boundary. The surfaces initially share that boundary; a 0.4% uniform fit gives about 1.87 mm clearance per jamb and 4.33 mm additional top/bottom clearance. No frame is imported or invented.

component_splits.review: The outer U comprises two jambs and a header; select all original central leaf faces inside the visible molding boundary. Retain outside faces as Frame at index 2; append the leaf as index 4. Source geometry is welded at this seam; connectivity alone does not establish missing frame.

shell_backings.review: Source leaf is a front-only relief. Preserve every front triangle/UV; add a flat rear at inspected X=0.01 and close its boundary. The inferred thickness is about 53.6 mm at 0.75 scale. Rear repeats the source front UVs; this is an explicit simulation reconstruction, not recovered source geometry. Frame retains its original profile and bounded volumetric colliders.

modifications: Split the existing welded frame/leaf at its visible boundary; preserve source faces, UVs and original download.
Close the front-only leaf with an explicitly inferred rear plane and boundary walls, retaining its decorative front.
Uniform scale 0.75, proper rotation to Z-up and floor-centered opening; infer left hinge opposite the original handle at the opening-face corner. No mirrored geometry.
Apply 0.4% moving-assembly fit for operating clearance; preserve handle colliders.
Use one conservative solid-leaf hull (fills decorative recesses) and separate frame-part hulls. The source has no separate latch; start closed and unlatched.
